WORKTREE SAFETY: run `pwd` before your first write and after any resume; the path must be your claimed worktree under {{worktree_root}} and never inside the main checkout ({{main_checkout}}). Verify with `relay-worktree verify`. If your worktree is missing, create it with `relay-worktree create {{issue}} --runtime {{runtime}}`. Never use a shared long-lived worktree. Commit only on your claimed branch `{{branch}}`. Avoid `git stash`. `git pull` before pushing follow-ups. The orchestrator syncs the default branch into PR branches before merging.
